description: UCM + China intl + strong RD (no highSchoolLocation)
rationale: UCM anchor ~0.88-0.92 (CDS-band fixture). Per PR-8 fix (4/26): intl multiplier is now selectivity-aware — UCM at 88% overall → 0.95× (essentially no penalty, since UCM admits ~85% of intl per IPEDS). Strong stats × 1.3 × 1.5 push result to the 2.5×-anchor cap → 0.98 ceiling. Range [0.85, 0.98] reflects 'strong intl applicant at less-selective school = essentially admit'. Pre-fix this case returned ~0.69 due to flat 0.4× penalty.
